questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: In which sport is the term "googly" used?
questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: World Water Day is observed on:
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: In which year was the Quit India Movement launched?
questions.explanation: It was launched on 8 August 1942.

questions.question: The "Make in India" initiative was launched in:
questions.explanation: Make in India was launched in September 2014.

questions.question: The currency of Japan is the:
questions.explanation: Japan’s currency is the Yen.

questions.explanation: Multiples: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30. Sum = 90. Average = 90/5 = 18.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 7 and their sum is 70. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 10. Each part = 70/10 = 7. Larger = 7 × 7 = 49.

questions.question: A train 100 m long crosses a pole in 5 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 5 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/5 = 25/100. Time = 100/25 = 4 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 14 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √400.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹720. Find its marked price.
Find 10% of 20% of 800.
Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their difference is 12. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 12, so each part = 4. Smaller = 2 × 4 = 8.

questions.question: A boat travels 51 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 51/3 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 4 = 13 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Thursday, what day will it be after 56 days?
questions.explanation: 56 mod 7 = 0; Thursday + 0 = Thursday.

questions.question: Which letter is 3rd to the right of the 6th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 6th letter = F; 6 + 3 = 9th letter = I.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (9, 734), (6, 216), (2, 8), (4, 64)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 9³ = 729, not 734.

questions.question: In a row of 31 students, Ravi is 14th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 31 − 14 + 1 = 18.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 12, so 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.question: If RAIN is coded as VEMR, how is DOG coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to DOG gives HSK.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 2:00 the angle is 2 × 30° = 60°.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km East and then 8 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 4 + 4 × 6.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 4 × 4 − 6 = 16 − 6 = 10.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 10, 31, 94, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3 + 1: 94 × 3 + 1 = 283.

questions.question: Complete the series: B, E, H, K, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is N.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 19, 8, 2, 23
questions.explanation: 2, 19, 23 are prime numbers; 8 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 3rd from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 3rd letter from the right is the 24th from the left = X.
